subject.title: fix(onboard): honor remote flags in interactive setup

question: Should interactive onboarding deliberately clear inherited remote token/password credentials whenever an explicitly supplied `--remote-url` changes the endpoint, unless the same invocation supplies `--remote-token`?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proof-backed, but this is an intentional compatibility and credential-selection rule for existing CLI users under the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Confirm isolation and merge
options.body: Accept endpoint-scoped credential isolation, then merge once the failing type-check is resolved on the current head.

options.title: Preserve inherited credentials
options.body: Require a revised rule if maintainers want an explicit remote URL to retain a previously stored token or password by default.
